trial_court: Sessions Judge, Rajahmundry (Criminal Appeal No. 338 of 1959)
case_name: Padullaparthi Mutyala Paradeshi vs Padullaparthi Subbalakshmi And Anr.
facts_of_case: The petitioner contracted a marriage with the 2nd accused, who is his second wife, despite having a previous wife. The trial court convicted the petitioner and sentenced him to imprisonment.

legal_principles.principle: The onus of proof in respect of the validity of a marriage lies with the party alleging bigamy.
legal_principles.held: We consider that embarking upon such an enquiry is essential in view of the argument of the learned Counsel that the provision contained in Section 7 Of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 created a special rule of evidence in supersession of any presumptions which may arise in respect of the validity of a marriage even when in fact it has been found to have been truly performed.

legal_principles.principle: The statements of a person who had special means of knowledge and when such a statement was made before the question in dispute was raised, is made admissible under Sub-section (5) of Section 32 of the Indian Evidence Act.
legal_principles.held: At the outset, it Is necessary to remember that in proving the existence of any relationship by marriage, the statements of a person who had special means of knowledge and when such a statement was made before the question in dispute was raised, is made admissible under Sub-section (5) of Section 32 of the Indian Evidence Act

legal_principles.principle: The proof of fact at marriage is not to depend on opinion or conduct evidence.
legal_principles.held: But the proviso Section 50 makes such opinion insufficient to prove a marriage in proceedings under the Indian Divorce Act (IV of 1889) or in prosecutions Under Sections 494, 495, 497 or 498 of the Indian Penal Code

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging bigamy to prove the invalidity of the second marriage.
legal_principles.held: We will advert to this second point later. Before then, we will proceed to consider the state of decided authorities so far as made available to this Court

outcome.final_order: The conviction and sentence imposed on the 1st accused were confirmed, but the appeal of the 3rd accused was allowed.

use_for_drafting: assisting in nullity of marriage proceedings
